title: Microsoft Edge: expanded enforcement controls for Data Loss Prevention connectors
summary: Hold: the Intune control path starts inside an unidentified policy rather than explaining how to reach it from the admin centre. The roadmap facts and cited policy fields are supported, and the previously reported fetch failures did not recur.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure and Autonomy
claims.claim: When enabled, a connector sends content from specific user actions to an on-device DLP agent.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Why it matters
claims.claim: Edge for Business connectors natively enforce DLP verdicts from on-device agents.
claims.quote: Microsoft Edge for Business Data Loss Prevention Connectors enable Microsoft Edge for Business to natively enforce DLP (Data Loss Prevention) verdicts from on-device agents.

claims.claim: Setting block_until_verdict to 1 makes Edge wait for an analysis response before giving the page access to data.
claims.quote: If set to 1, Microsoft Edge waits for a response from the analysis service before giving the page access to the data.

claims.claim: Any other integer value for block_until_verdict gives the page immediate access to data.
claims.quote: Any other integer value allows the page to access the data immediately.

claims.where: What's changing; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The DLP connector overview lists Symantec DLP, Trellix and Cisco Secure Access as providers.
claims.quote: Symantec DLP; Trellix; Cisco Secure Access

claims.claim: The DLP connector overview lists paste, print and upload as actions that can send content.
claims.quote: The following user actions can send content to the Data Loss Prevention Connector: Paste; Print; Upload

claims.claim: Download is not on the connector overview's published action list.
claims.quote: Searched: Edge DLP connectors enforcement download upload paste print; read the entire DLP connector overview. Its User Actions list contains Paste, Print and Upload, not Download.

claims.claim: Existing connectors require configuration.
claims.quote: This policy requires additional setup to take effect.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Why it matters
claims.claim: The fallback verdict controls the outcome of a communication error between Edge and the DLP agent.
claims.quote: Choose to ‘Allow file access’ or ‘Block file access’. This determines the default verdict if a communication error between Edge and the DLP agent occurs.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The upload, paste and print connector policies each expose verdict-waiting and error-fallback settings.
claims.quote: Configure any combination of the following 3 settings ... Paste ... Upload ... Print ... Configure the following fields in the policy ... block_until_verdict ... default_action

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Symantec recommends default_action allow, which permits data access on an analysis-service contact error.
claims.quote: Configure the following fields in the policy with the recommended values from Symantec: default_action | allow

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Why it matters
claims.claim: default_action block denies access on an analysis-service contact error; other values permit access.
claims.quote: If set to block, Microsoft Edge denies page access to the data if an error occurs while contacting the analysis service. Any other value permits the page to access the data.

claims.claim: The upload policy already documents require_justification_tags.
claims.quote: require_justification_tags Lists the analysis tags whose bypassable warnings require the user to enter a justification before proceeding.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: The paste policy's require_justification_tags requires a user-entered justification for warnings with the listed analysis tags.
claims.quote: Lists the analysis tags whose bypassable warnings require the user to enter a justification before proceeding.

claims.claim: Omitting require_justification_tags means no justification is required.
claims.quote: If omitted, no justification is required.

claims.claim: The documented bypass justification is a statement the user enters, not an approval workflow.
claims.quote: require_justification_tags Lists the analysis tags whose bypassable warnings require the user to enter a justification before proceeding.

claims.claim: The roadmap does not say whether the planned justification control extends or replaces require_justification_tags.
claims.quote: Additional controls include required bypass justification and administrator-defined guidance.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented retention or administrator access for the planned bypass explanations.
claims.quote: Searched: Edge connectors administrator guidance message policy bypass justification retained reporting; 579894 justification reporting retention. Read upload/paste/print references and reporting-event excerpts; none describes storage or admin access for the planned explanations.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope: Who is covered
claims.claim: The Symantec setup requires end users to sign in to Edge for Business with a valid Microsoft Entra ID.
claims.quote: Ensure that end-users sign in to Microsoft Edge for Business with a valid Microsoft Entra ID.

claims.where: Scope: Who is covered; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The connector route uses a supported third-party DLP agent on the device, including Symantec DLP Endpoint or Trellix DLP Endpoint.
claims.quote: This connector ensures a secure browsing experience through an API integration between Edge for Business and Trellix Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Endpoint for Windows.

claims.where: Scope: Not the same as Purview browser DLP
claims.claim: Edge for Business separately enforces Microsoft Purview DLP policies inline in the browser.
claims.quote: Edge for Business enforces Purview DLP policies inline directly in browser

claims.claim: Purview inline DLP is a separate control route from configuring third-party connectors.
claims.quote: Microsoft Edge for Business Data Loss Prevention Connectors enable Microsoft Edge for Business to natively enforce DLP (Data Loss Prevention) verdicts from on-device agents.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Microsoft Edge > Connectors reaches the connector configuration experience.
claims.quote: In the main left navigation bar, go to Settings > Microsoft Edge. Navigate to the Connectors tab.
claims.fix: The path correctly stops on the connector page. For the Symantec example, complete it as 'Settings > Microsoft Edge > Connectors > Discover Connectors > Symantec DLP Connector > Set up > Chosen policy > Enable data loss prevention for browser actions', using https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-connectors-symantec, already cited.

claims.claim: OnFileAttachedEnterpriseConnector can configure upload analysis through service_provider, enable and disable using Group Policy or registry.
claims.quote: service_provider Identifies the analysis service provider the configuration applies to. ... url_list, tags, enable, disable ... determine whether the connector sends data for analysis ... GP unique name: OnFileAttachedEnterpriseConnector

claims.claim: A configuration policy must exist before assigning a connector configuration.
claims.quote: Admins must set up a configuration policy to assign to any Connector configuration.

claims.claim: On the connector page, Symantec setup is under Discover Connectors > Symantec DLP Connector > Set up.
claims.quote: Under Discover Connectors, locate the Symantec DLP Connector and select Set up.

claims.claim: The Intune route starts at policy > Configuration settings > Microsoft Edge > Configuration policy for files attached for Microsoft Edge for Business Data Loss Prevention Connectors.
claims.quote: If you've chosen to create an Intune policy, you can navigate to intune.microsoft.com > Devices > Configuration where you should see your newly created configuration policy in this list.
claims.fix: Replace the path with 'Devices > Configuration > policy > Configuration settings > Microsoft Edge > Configuration policy for files attached for Microsoft Edge for Business Data Loss Prevention Connectors'. The entry route is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-management-service and the remaining labels at https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-connectors-symantec; both are already cited. Apply the same replacement to the rendered table.

claims.claim: OnFileAttachedEnterpriseConnector exposes block_until_verdict and default_action through Group Policy or registry for upload only.
claims.quote: Specifies ... service settings that apply when users attach files in Microsoft Edge. ... block_until_verdict ... default_action ... Registry settings ... Value name: OnFileAttachedEnterpriseConnector

claims.claim: The paste and print policy settings are alongside the upload policy under Microsoft Edge in Intune.
claims.quote: Paste: Microsoft Edge > Configuration policy for bulk data entry for Microsoft Edge for Business Data Loss Prevention Connectors ... Print: Microsoft Edge > Configuration policy for print for Microsoft Edge for Business Data Loss Prevention Connectors

claims.claim: No separate admin-centre UI for the roadmap's planned bypass-justification control is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Edge DLP Enterprise Connector administrator guidance require justification tags Intune warning bypass UI; require_justification_tags Intune Edge. Read Symantec setup, Intune configuration and paste reference; existing dictionary fields are documented, not a separate planned UI.

claims.claim: The existing paste policy can configure require_justification_tags using OnBulkDataEntryEnterpriseConnector in Group Policy or registry.
claims.quote: require_justification_tags Lists the analysis tags whose bypassable warnings require the user to enter a justification before proceeding. ... GP unique name: OnBulkDataEntryEnterpriseConnector ... Value name: OnBulkDataEntryEnterpriseConnector
